name: ogbg-molpcba: Molecular Property Prediction
description: The ogbg-molpcba dataset is a large molecular property prediction benchmark from the Open Graph Benchmark (OGB), curated from PubChem BioAssay. It contains 437,929 chemical molecules represented as 2D graphs where nodes are atoms and edges are chemical bonds. The task is multi-task binary classification predicting biological assay activities across 128 distinct bioassays, using scaffold splitting to evaluate structural generalization.

license.name: Public Domain / MIT
license.notes: Underlying PubChem data is US public domain; OGB benchmark utilities under MIT.

verification.notes: Verified graph count (437,929), 128 bioassay tasks, and scaffold split protocol.

citation.paper_title: Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs
